title: ACM International Conference on Neuromorphic Systems (ICONS)
summary: The ACM ICONS conference serves as a forum for neuromorphic systems research including novel architectures and energy-efficient AI. The 2026 edition focuses on ultra-low-power spike-based machine learning, event-driven computation, in-memory computing, and hardware co-design aligned with the U.S. Department of Energy's Genesis Mission goals.
tldr: ICONS is a premier forum for neuromorphic systems research focusing on energy-efficient AI architectures and algorithms.
evidence: ICONS brings together researchers advancing brain-inspired computing and neuromorphic systems.
This year, ICONS is welcoming work at the intersection of neuromorphic computing and energy-efficient AI.
